title: Japanese SemCor (JSemCor): A Sense-tagged Corpus of Japanese
description:
A sense-tagged corpus of Japanese, created by translating the English SemCor corpus and projecting the sense tags from English onto the Japanese translation. It contains 116 texts from the Brown Corpus (about 14,000 sentences), with content words tagged with synsets from the Japanese Wordnet (version 1.1).

Version 1.0 (2011-12-12) is the release described in the GWC 2012 paper. Version 1.1 (2012-03-05) adds closed-class terms, links from each Japanese word to the English SemCor 3.0 token it translates, and a sanitised copy of the database of the translation interface.

The data are in the Kyoto Annotation Format (KAF). JSemCor is released under the same license as the English SemCor, the Princeton WordNet license (see the LICENSE file).
